rule: edit: one comment line inside every multi-line symbol the item's labels name, else inside every multi-line function/method, else inside the longest other multi-line non-module symbol, of the first ground-truth file that has one of that tier; rename: the first other ground-truth file, else the edited file's neighbour with the most symbols, to <name>_renamed<ext>; delete: the edited file's neighbour with the most symbols (same repository, nearest directory, never an answer, a test or a documentation file)
